title: CBSStateSyncContractV1
description: Phase 1 (ADR-041) request/response shapes for the CBS state-sync MCP tools: state_read, state_write, state_delete, state_since. Delivered as MCP tool call arguments/results, not REST or gRPC routes, because agent-platform/cortxt_mcp/tools.py is transport-agnostic and tool-call based -- there is no HTTP route table to extend. This resolves the wire-protocol question ADR-041 explicitly left open: CBS Phase 1 state sync rides the existing MCP tool-call transport rather than introducing a new one.

state_read_response.description: A category with no state written yet is not an error: it returns version: 0, updated_at set to the read time, and payload: {} (an empty object), rather than a state_conflict_error or any other error shape.

expected_version.description: Optional optimistic-concurrency check. Omit to write unconditionally.

state_write_response.description: Returned on a successful write. If the request carried expected_version and it no longer matches the stored version (optimistic-concurrency conflict), the call returns a state_conflict_error instead of a state_write_response.

state_conflict_error.description: Returned instead of state_write_response when a state_write_request's expected_version does not match the category's current stored version (optimistic-concurrency mismatch).

since_cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a prior state_since_response, or null to request a full sync.

items.description: Exactly one of payload (present) or deleted: true must appear. payload's presence implies the change is not a deletion; deleted: true represents a deletion and carries no payload.
